en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a town square with several people, mostly children, standing in the foreground. Dominating the scene is a large historic building with a clock tower, labeled 'Ratskeller' on the facade, indicating it houses a traditional German restaurant or tavern. Other visible signs read 'Westlausitzer Zeitung' (a newspaper), and 'Polizei Wache' (police station). The postcard text at the top reads 'Königsbrück. Markt mit Rathaus,' suggesting this is the market square with the town hall. The architectural style and dress of the people suggest an early 20th-century setting.
